7ae79fa7e63f017f.content_excerpt: Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product. This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment. We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System . Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype. dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness . It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person. It is also a way of working with an agent: take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible. ed1d67fc0ab0bf64.content_excerpt: High-reliability, multi-agent-safe LinkedIn automation engine and CLI built on Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Disclaimer & Responsible Use : linkedin-ops is an independent open-source tool built for developer automation research, testing, and workflow automation via local Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by LinkedIn Corporation. Automated interaction with LinkedIn must comply with applicable platform terms and policies. Always maintain realistic human delays and respect LinkedIn rate limits to safeguard account health. Checks CDP port 9222 reachability, browser version, user agent, and verifies an authenticated LinkedIn session. (Dry-run mode navigates and fills the note without submitting. Add --send only when ready to live submit). For multi-profile outreach and candidate sweeps, see campaigns/batch-connect.example.mjs : (User campaigns and harvested datasets in data/ and campaigns/ are gitignored and never committed to source control).
